definition: a person who does work without being paid; to do such work
vi: tình nguyện viên; làm tình nguyện
example: I volunteer at the community kitchen every second Saturday.

definition: a public building where people in an area meet for activities and services
example: The community centre offers free English conversation circles on Tuesday evenings.

definition: an organization that collects food and gives it to people in need
vi: ngân hàng thực phẩm (nơi phát thực phẩm miễn phí)
example: Demand at the local food bank has risen sharply as grocery prices go up.

definition: an activity you can join without booking in advance
vi: chương trình tham gia tự do (không cần đăng ký trước)
example: The library runs a drop-in program for parents and toddlers every Wednesday morning.

definition: to put your name on a list to take part in something
example: I signed up for a free tax clinic at the neighbourhood house.

definition: programs that help immigrants settle in a new country
vi: dịch vụ hỗ trợ người mới nhập cư
example: MOSAIC and other agencies offer newcomer services such as job search help and language classes.

definition: without any cost
example: The workshop is free of charge, but space is limited to twenty people.

definition: a card that lets you borrow books and use library services
example: With a library card, you can also borrow museum passes and e-books.

definition: an event organized to collect money for a cause
example: Our school's pancake breakfast fundraiser raised over $3,000 for new playground equipment.

definition: money or goods given to help a person or organization
vi: sự quyên góp, đồ/tiền quyên góp
example: The shelter accepts donations of winter coats and blankets.

definition: a group that uses its income to help people rather than make a profit
example: She works for a non-profit organization that helps refugees find housing.

definition: efforts to bring services or information to people who need them
vi: hoạt động tiếp cận cộng đồng
example: The health authority expanded its outreach to seniors who live alone.

definition: older people, usually over 65
example: The centre offers chair yoga and computer classes for seniors.

definition: a place or service that looks after young children while parents work
vi: nhà trẻ, dịch vụ giữ trẻ ban ngày
example: The waiting list for a licensed daycare in our area is over a year long.

definition: an organized activity for teenagers or young people
vi: chương trình dành cho thanh thiếu niên
example: The after-school youth program keeps teens busy with sports and homework help.

definition: a short class where people learn a practical skill together
vi: hội thảo thực hành, lớp học kỹ năng ngắn hạn
example: I attended a résumé workshop that showed me how to write for Canadian employers.

definition: lessons for learning a language
example: Permanent residents can take free English language classes through the LINC program.

definition: a group of people with a similar problem who meet to help each other
vi: nhóm hỗ trợ, nhóm tương trợ
example: After moving to Canada, my mother joined a support group for new grandparents.

definition: earning little money
example: The program offers free bus passes to low-income families.

definition: to have a good effect on a person or situation
vi: tạo ra sự khác biệt, có tác động tích cực
example: Even an hour a week of volunteering can make a difference in a child's life.
collocations: make a difference in the community

definition: to help the place and people that have helped you
vi: đóng góp lại cho cộng đồng
example: After the settlement agency helped my family, I wanted to give back to the community.
collocations: a way to give back to the community
want to give back to the community

definition: information passed from person to person by talking
example: Most new members heard about the club by word of mouth, not through ads.

definition: anyone is allowed to come
example: The town hall meeting is open to the public, and no registration is required.
collocations: free and open to the public
open to the public on weekends

definition: a list of people waiting for something that is not yet available
example: The swimming lessons are full, but I can put your name on the waiting list.

definition: a shared piece of land where local people grow plants and vegetables
example: We rent a small plot in the community garden and grow tomatoes every summer.
